objective_value: <float> Total diversity score, computed as the sum of pairwise distances between all pairs of elements assigned to the same group, across all groups.
assignment: <dict, key: '{element}'> Group to which each element is assigned, where keys are zero-indexed element identifiers and values are zero-indexed group identifiers.
groups: <dict, key: '{group}'> List of elements assigned to each group, where keys are zero-indexed group identifiers and values are sorted lists of zero-indexed element identifiers.
